title: M30 Champion Soft Lot Filter Deactivation Test
research_question: Does deactivating soft lot throttling (InpUseH4Soft=false and InpUseAdxSoft=false) increase total net profit by capturing full 1.0% risk payoffs on winning trades, while keeping maximal equity drawdown within prop firm limits (<= 6.0%) on GBPUSD M30?
hypothesis: Because the entry filter cascade (H1 EMA 50, RSI tiers, MACD, and rejection wicks) already achieves a 74%-82% win rate, secondary soft lot throttling unnecessarily shrinks winning payoffs to 0.6x or 0.3x lot size. Disabling both soft lot filters will allow winning trades to capture full 1.0% risk payouts, increasing total net profit while keeping maximal drawdown comfortably below 6.0%.

facts: EXP-0022 achieved +$583.78 net profit and 2.07% max drawdown on GBPUSD M30 in training (2020-2024) with InpUseH4Soft=true and InpUseAdxSoft=true.
EXP-0023 achieved +$505.25 net profit, 74.58% win rate, and 3.88% max drawdown on GBPUSD M30 in validation (2025).
In both experiments, trades confirmed during counter-H4 trend or weak H1 ADX (<22) had position sizes scaled down to 0.6x or 0.3x.
Because the baseline win rate is 74.6% to 82.4%, the majority of throttled positions were winning trades, dampening total net profit.
inferences: Removing soft lot throttling will increase average win amounts from $35-$57 to full $60-$90 payoffs.
Unthrottled losses will also increase, but the high win rate (74%+) should expand overall net expectancy.
evidence: EXP-0022 total_trades=17, profit_factor=3.68, win_rate=82.35%, total_net_profit=583.78, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=2.07
EXP-0023 total_trades=59, profit_factor=1.49, win_rate=74.58%, total_net_profit=505.25, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=3.88

independent_variables.name: InpUseH4Soft
independent_variables.rationale: Disable H4 counter-trend lot reduction to allow full 1.0% risk sizing.

independent_variables.name: InpUseAdxSoft
independent_variables.rationale: Disable ADX momentum lot reduction to allow full 1.0% risk sizing.

assumptions: Hard H1 EMA 50 trend filter and tiered RSI/MACD confirmations provide adequate protection against adverse market regimes.
Drawdown guards (4% daily, 8% total) will protect capital if full-sized losses cluster.
expected_observations: Total net profit exceeds baseline EXP-0022 (+$583.78).
Average profit per winning trade increases.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit decreases or fails to meaningfully improve relative to baseline.
